First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @GoodWeatherInSeattle the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Good Weather Sunday Social group ride

An all-inclusive casual ride from Tailwind Cafe on Capitol Hill with rotating leaders and a new route each week. Park sits and pastry stops are part of the plan. Rain or shine; ice or snow cancels.
